source.note: the token-creation -> REPLACEMENT intercept MODIFIER witness (ADR-0001 §4 modifier arm: emit:token -> replace:token-creation intercept). A pure token-DOUBLER ('creates twice that many instead', CR 614) intercepting a token-maker's emit:token; corroborates Chatterfang C1's replacement intercept (a card-specific token-ADDER) with the canonical doubler shape. Not a CSB combo (a synergy, not a loop) -> no popularity.

judge.ref: interaction-judge PASS (accretion batch 8, 2026-07-17): 8/8 PASS, no false GREEN/prune; AMBER floors sound-irreducible; GREEN edges CR-guaranteed. CR-citation drift fixed where genuinely wrong (evolution-sage proliferate 701.27->701.34).

Grave Titan.note: 'create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens' — dump: emit:token:creature:zombie:controlled (GREEN). The enters-or-attacks trigger that drives it is internal to Grave Titan and irrelevant to this witness.

Anointed Procession.note: 'If an effect would create one or more tokens under your control, it creates twice that many of those tokens instead' — a CR 614 replacement watching the token-creation event. Dump: intercept replace:token-creation (family replacement, GREEN). Same port shape as Chatterfang C1 (a doubler, not an adder — the magnitude difference is card-defined, not port-structural).

notes: the ADR-0001 §4 modifier arm: an emit:token (deployment ⊇ deployment:creature[token]) is intercepted by a replace:token-creation replacement (CR 614.1 — a replacement watches the token-creation event and replaces it). control=you covers control=you -> the mandatory replacement applies -> GREEN. mechanism=modifier is structural/self-certifying (like subsumption/card-defined) -> no rule id. Intercept never closes a loop alone (CR 614.5 — a replacement doesn't re-invoke itself, so the doubled tokens aren't re-doubled).

assertions.because: the emit:token -> replace:token-creation intercept relation is the structural §4 modifier arm; self-certifying, no rule cited
control=you ⊆ control=you and a token-creation replacement is mandatory (CR 614.1); the doubler deterministically intercepts the maker's token creation
unit=pairwise: a one-shot magnitude modifier, not a repeating cycle (CR 614.5 — the replacement gets one opportunity, it does not re-double its own output); no §10 SDF balance
